description: The OPTIONS paragraph - a 2002 introduction (the 2002 standard added it with the ARITHMETIC clause; Annex E.2 item 21's obsolete-in-2014 Standard Arithmetic back-derives the container; the OPTIONS reserved word is 2002). Below 2002 the binder still returns OptionsModel.Default (silent routing - the pass owns the diagnostic). The 2014-only clauses (DEFAULT ROUNDED / INTERMEDIATE ROUNDING / ENTRY-CONVENTION / FLOAT-BINARY / FLOAT-DECIMAL / INITIALIZE, and the STANDARD-BINARY / STANDARD-DECIMAL keywords) carry their own per-clause 2014 rows (P10 Step 12).
